minding_the_house_v2.title: Minding the House: A Biographical Guide to Prince Edward Island MLAs, volume 2 (MLAs sitting 1993-2017)
minding_the_house_v2.publisher: Legislative Assembly of Prince Edward Island

assembly_member_pages.note: Official Legislative Assembly member biography pages, 2019 snapshot via Wayback (used only for the four members first elected in April 2019, who postdate Minding the House v2).

coding_rules.education_level: Coded from the credential the source attests. Post-secondary attendance with no credential stated is coded 'unknown' (the institution is still recorded in alma_maters). Completed community-college / vocational diplomas and certificates (Holland College, RCMP Academy, Prince of Wales College diploma) are coded 'college'. 'professional' is used for LL.B, dentistry, optometry.
coding_rules.occupation_category: Coded from the pre-political employment the biography describes, preferring the role held immediately before entering the Assembly when two careers are co-equal. Fishing is folded into 'agriculture'. Genuinely mixed cases with no dominant category are coded 'other', with the full text kept in prior_occupation.
